Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect normalization rule to convert any “Palos Verdes” variant (including Palos Verdes Estates) to “Rancho Palos Verdes, CA.” This conflates distinct cities on the Palos Verdes Peninsula and contradicts the cited Los Angeles Times obituary stating Palos Verdes Estates. This unjustified normalization would lead to the wrong death location, deviating from the correct answer (“Palos Verdes”) and the evidence-backed specific location (“Palos Verdes Estates”).
